Branch

Heritage

A cluster, used for life

The Preservation Project, Hathihe Ramallah and the Bookstore. There is no "next" here and no milestone invitations: people come and go all their lives, and nobody graduates from the archive to the magazine.

Programmes on this branch

Ramallah Preservation Project

A digital archive of Ramallah's history, begun in 2020: photographs, documents, articles and oral histories with migrants and first-generation Americans, shown at convention exhibits and with a museum partner.

Plan only other
Hathihe Ramallah

The Federation's magazine since 1952, in English and Arabic, carrying family news, recognition lists and statutory notices. On the platform its printed sections are generated from live data at a copy freeze.

Built other
Bookstore

An online store for books, magazine back issues, clan books, merchandise and digital downloads, with member pricing for members in good standing.

Built other

How people move along it

A cluster, used for life. There is no next step and no milestone invitation. People take part in any of these at any point in life. Inside every programme, people move through the same five rungs: hear · show up · take part · give or serve · lead (D25).

Outcomes this branch reports

  • Contributions to the archive and the magazine
  • Readers and subscribers
  • Members who take part in more than one heritage activity

How outcomes are measured for each branch is itself an open question (Q-19).
